claims.claim: There is an explicit packing of 518 A10 rectangles in one A1 rectangle.
claims.evidence: Exact generation produced 64+14+440=518 distinct rectangles. Every rectangle has dimensions 37×26 or 26×37, lies in [0,594]×[0,841], and the occupied-unit-cell sets are pairwise disjoint. They cover exactly 518·37·26=498316 cells and leave 1238 cells uncovered.
claims.search_method: Generated every stated rectangle using exact integers and exhaustively marked every covered unit cell to check dimensions, containment, uniqueness, and non-overlap.

claims.claim: No packing can contain 519 A10 rectangles; a ten-residue periodic marker certificate gives the upper bound 518.
claims.evidence: For the stated ten residue pairs modulo 37, exact enumeration of all 37 cyclic starts shows that every length-26 interval contains 7 or 8 selected first-coordinate residues and 7 or 8 selected second-coordinate residues. Exact prefix-sum enumeration confirms that all 455328 placements of size 37×26 and all 458045 placements of size 26×37 contain 7 or 8 marks. The container contains exactly 3632 marks, while 519 rectangles would require at least 519·7=3633 disjoint marks. The extension to real coordinates is valid: with vertical coordinates and orientations fixed, the feasible horizontal-coordinate set is nonempty and compact; a minimizer of the coordinate sum gives every nonboundary rectangle a touching left blocker. Following strictly decreasing blocker chains to x=0 expresses every x-coordinate as a sum of integer widths. Fixing those x-coordinates and repeating vertically makes every y-coordinate integral without reducing cardinality.
claims.search_method: Used exact integer arithmetic to enumerate all 913373 integer placements, independently counted the full marker grid, checked every cyclic residue interval, and audited the compact-minimizer blocker-chain reduction for arbitrary real coordinates.

target_evidence: The literal target concerns A10 rectangles of size 26×37 in an A1 rectangle of size 594×841. The verified construction gives 518 placements, immediately disproving both proposed values 258 and 259, while the verified marker certificate proves that 519 placements are impossible even when arbitrary real coordinates are allowed. Thus the draft establishes the stronger exact classification OPT(594,841,37,26)=518 and fully resolves the target rather than merely giving a coarser or mismatched result. Its claimed_resolution of FULL is therefore accurate.
